definitions.explanation: The process of purifying metals by removing impurities, typically through heating or chemical processes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{銅|どう}→銅：19443_dou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{精錬|せいれん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{古|ふる}く→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{金|きん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{精錬|せいれん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{栄|さか}えた→栄える：13104_sakaeru⟧。
examples.english: This region prospered from gold refining since ancient times.

examples.japanese: {精錬|せいれん}⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{向上|こうじょう}→向上：02731_koujou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧、より⟦{純度|じゅんど}→純度：18774_jundo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{金属|きんぞく}→金属：02645_kinzoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{得|え}られる→得る：02014_eru⟧ようになった。
examples.english: Advances in refining technology have made it possible to obtain metals of higher purity.

notes:
A technical term for the process of purifying metals. Composed of {精|せい} (purify, refine) + {錬|れん} (temper, forge). Used in industrial, historical, and scientific contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {精錬|せいれん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to refine, to smelt
- {精錬|せいれん}{所|じょ}/{精錬|せいれん}⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧: refinery, smelting plant
- {精錬|せいれん}⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧: refining technology
- ⟦{銅|どう}→銅：19443_dou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{精錬|せいれん}: copper smelting

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{製錬|せいれん}→製錬：24155_seiren⟧: smelting — same reading, used specifically for extracting metal from ore; often used interchangeably
- ⟦{精製|せいせい}→精製：21559_seisei⟧: refining, purification — broader; includes oil, sugar, chemicals
- ⟦{鍛錬|たんれん}→鍛錬：08190_tanren⟧: tempering, training — physical or metal forging; also used figuratively for self-discipline
- ⟦{冶金|やきん}→冶金：24156_yakin⟧: metallurgy — the science of working with metals

NOTE ON KANJI:
{精錬|せいれん} and ⟦{製錬|せいれん}→製錬：24155_seiren⟧ are often confused. Strictly, ⟦{製錬|せいれん}→製錬：24155_seiren⟧ refers to extracting metal from raw ore, while {精錬|せいれん} refers to further purifying already-extracted metal.
